description: Latest admitted vendor observation for the latest physical-player clip attempt. This is separate from ordinary group playback. Missing, expired or revoked observations are unavailable, never inferred completion. Command acceptance alone supplies no value; physical clips do not support pause or resume.

value.description: Bounded passive telemetry for an exactly correlated physical-player command. This observation cannot authorize controls, retry playback or establish audible delivery.

attemptId.description: Port OS correlation for the latest admitted command, not a vendor media identifier or authorization token.

status.description: Vendor-reported physical clip lifecycle. SCHEDULED is command acceptance and is excluded. Unknown values and silence do not imply DONE.

errorCode.description: Allowlisted Sonos clip error identifier. Omit unrecognized codes and vendor error text rather than exposing arbitrary payloads.

provenance.description: Assurance of passive Sonos telemetry. Header authentication, exact issued-command correlation and ordering do not authenticate the event body. This is never proof of audible delivery or authority for automatic controls.

assurance.description: Signed headers were verified against configured application credentials; the body remains unsigned.

payloadIntegrity.description: Always false because Sonos does not sign the callback payload.

provenance.title: MediaClipProvenance
